title: tetracera asiatica subsp. sumatrana
intro: Tetracera asiatica subsp. sumatrana, commonly known as the Sumatran staff vine, is a plant species that belongs to the family Erythroxylaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tetracera asiatica subsp. sumatrana include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
